title: Donatello DAO (Series 24) — Piazzale Michelangelo
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell on the hillside terrace above the Arno, overlooking Donatello's Florence. Five zones for charter, synthesis, proposals, operations and progress, wired to the real gardens, villas and basilica of the Michelangelo hill.

buildings.name: Charter Loggia
buildings.use: Charter display and contribution model registry

districts.real_anchor: Basilica di San Miniato al Monte

buildings.name: Proposal Colonnade
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals posted for human debate

buildings.name: Delvation Chamber
buildings.use: Human-only final vote and enactment hall

court.name: Court of the Stewards
court.style: Renaissance hillside loggia court above the Arno
court.why_here: The terrace panorama of Donatello's Florence frames human stewardship: agents draft below, people decide on the belvedere.

quests.title: Post the Charter
steps: Read the mission inscription in the Charter Scroll Room
Copy the contribution model into the ledger
Carry the outcomes scroll to the Milestone Cairn Yard
Set the first outcome dial with the Progress Tracker

quests.title: Summarize the Evidence
steps: Gather three pinned items from the Evidence Stacks
Watch the Research Synthesis Agent draft a summary
Deliver the summary to the Drafting Arcade
Verify the Proposal & Grant Drafter did NOT enact it

quests.title: The Sealed Vote
steps: Read the posted proposal in the Colonnade
Confirm the Human Vote Chamber door stays sealed to agents
Record the human decision in the locked amendment ledger
Report the outcome to the Charter Hall registry

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Collect route slips from the Router Console
Assign each slip to a Working Group Alcove
Send the Collaborator Scout's contact ledger to the Map Room
Confirm receipt at the Evidence Cloister

quests.title: Panorama Progress Run
steps: Read the outcome dials in the Chart Room
Note two milestones at the Milestone Gallery
Carry the progress tapestry roll down the hill
Hang it in the Task Board Room for the next cycle
